Verify unrelated user authentication and session handling still passes on both revisions.

checks.rationale: The new database URLs must not change the service CLI's documented command surface.

checks.rationale: Check that adding a migration credential does not disclose it or existing credentials through the Settings representation.

checks.rationale: Run the focused settings and database CLI suite on the patched snapshot; the complete repository verification was separately run in the authoritative worktree with the owner's in-progress extraction fix.

covers: Alembic chooses the migration URL rather than the runtime URL
migration ownership does not grant schema DDL to the application role
checks.rationale: On an isolated PostgreSQL instance, the runtime role is denied schema DDL while a different migrator role has it. The same-target Alembic upgrade must succeed using MIGRATION_DATABASE_URL and leave runtime DDL denied while runtime DML and schema inspection work.

covers: production migration URL target identity is checked before DDL
misconfigured migration endpoint cannot silently upgrade the runtime database
checks.rationale: Use two distinct databases on the same disposable PostgreSQL server. A mismatched migration target must be refused before either database is changed; the baseline silently applies Alembic using the runtime URL.

finding.summary: Production Alembic migrations and migration preflight shared the application runtime credential, preventing a least-privilege DML-only runtime principal and allowing startup migration behavior to rely on runtime DDL privileges.
